caption: The drawing is a colored, aerial map of a large, enclosed park or estate bordered by a thin tan outline resembling roads or boundaries. The central area is dominated by green sections representing grassy lawns, scattered with clusters and rows of green trees of various shapes and sizes. In the lower left quadrant is a formal garden, depicted with geometric shapes formed by tan paths dividing rectangular, square, and circular flower beds filled with patches of color, likely representing different flowers or plants in red, blue, yellow, and pink. The garden section is lined with rows of darker green trees or tall shrubs, and includes a circular central planting bed with radiating paths. Continuing up and right, there is a looped and curved tan path leading across the property and passing by dark-roofed, rectangular structures, likely buildings, which are surrounded by denser plantings of trees and flowering shrubs. Throughout the estate, groves and single trees are distributed, and some areas show groupings of smaller, rounded shapes shaded in pink and white, possibly indicating flowering trees or bushes. The overall composition uses soft hues of green for grass and trees, tan for paths, and subtle pastel colors for the flower beds. Some faint brown contour lines in the background suggest gentle elevation changes.
title: Jumel Estate
